theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_rescaled_divergence_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (t R M : ℝ) (X : Euclidean N → Euclidean N), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → 0 < t → 0 < R → closedBall x (t * R) ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ ball (0 : Euclidean N) R → (∀ y, ‖X y‖ ≤ M) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ z, Varifold.tangentialDivergence X z.1 z.2 ∂(rescaledMeasure V x t)| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M * (ENNReal.ofReal R ^ n / ENNReal.ofReal R) * (ENNReal.ofReal (t * R) * variationMeasure V (closedBall x (t * R)) / ENNReal.ofReal (t * R) ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
